title: Constructible module sheaves generate the category
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and Lambda a finite commutative ring. Every sheaf F of Lambda-modules on X_Et is a quotient of a coproduct of constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules.

source.place: Lemma 03SA, proof of part (1), using Lemmas 09Z5 and 09Z6 (constructible maps into constant sheaves)

proof.text: For every section of F over an etale object U, the constructible finite-presentation and finite-pushforward lemmas provide a constructible Lambda-module sheaf together with a map to F carrying a chosen generator to that section. Taking the coproduct over all such pairs (U,s) and using the sheaf-module Yoneda evaluation gives an epimorphism onto F; epimorphisms of sheaves are detected locally, so the maps are jointly locally surjective and the coproduct map is an epimorphism.
